title: BAI to Host Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course is crucial for developing coaching talent within India, directly impacting the future performance of Indian players.
summary: Badminton Association of India (BAI) announced Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Courses to be held at the National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14 to 23, 2026.

title: Regulations Released for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: The regulations govern a key domestic team championship, shaping competition for Indian state teams and players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and eligibility criteria for participating teams.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: This update directly affects the composition of India's women's doubles contingent for the World Junior Championships.
summary: A change in the women's doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 has been announced by BAI.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp is vital for preparing India's young talent for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships, fostering future champions.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: The implementation of the 3x15 scoring system will significantly alter gameplay and strategy for India's young domestic players in U-13, U-15, and U-17 categories.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships across U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
